damast.packages.inherit: Inherit access from the linked repository
damast.packages.inherit_help: People and Actions workflows with read access to the linked repository can download this package; with write access they can publish new versions.
damast.file_tree.label: File tree
damast.file_tree.load_error: Could not load the file tree.
damast.drafts.create_help: Cannot be merged until marked ready for review. Code owners are asked for review then.
damast.drafts.still_draft: This pull request is still a draft.
damast.drafts.ready_help: Marking it ready for review removes the %s title prefix and asks code owners for review.
damast.packages.new_packages_owners: Only people who can publish packages for this owner (default)
damast.packages.new_packages_repo_writer: Also repository writers and Actions workflows, in container, npm, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems and generic registries
damast.packages.new_packages_help: A new package name is claimed for everyone, so by default only owners create one. Writers of a linked repository can always publish new versions of its packages. Other registries, such as Debian, RPM, PyPI or Cargo, keep new names for owners because GitHub has no such registry and some publish one signed index per owner.
